ent on two lines before he had finished the row. Corner urn [[comp]]3160[[/]]. Cart under the neem [[comp]]1720[[/]]. Painted stall by the post box [[comp]]4050[[/]]. The widow with leaf plates [[comp]]2480[[/]]. Slip dated [[noted]]3 February 2026[[/]]. An old monsoon board still said 2650 and he would not honour it. He muttered bhai sahab, rate pakka nahi. Bulb and water sat outside every figure. He walked the row twice because the widow changed her mind and then changed it back.
